title: Research progress on nanomaterial-empowered electrochemical biosensors for the detection of cardiac troponin I
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26473-26489
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04555J, Review Article
Open Access

Ning Zhang, Yuxin Zhu, Fachuang Li, Yusong Wang, Zheng Fu, Mengda Jia, Xiaoran Zhan, Wanqing Zhang
This article reviews carbon-based, metal/ceramic matrix, MOFs composites in electrochemical sensing, FETs, ECLIA. Detecting cTnI via biosensors, it shows trends, offers clinical references, and promotes lab-to-clinic advancement.
